model.description: Betty's Eddies Orange Creme Ache Away PM brings targeted relief in a delicious 1:1:1 ratio chewable edible designed for nighttime comfort. This indica-leaning formula combines THC, CBC, and CBN to deliver relaxed, sleepy effects perfect for unwinding after a long day. Each chew features a creamy orange flavor profile that makes your evening routine something to look forward to. With 50mg total cannabinoids, this balanced ratio product offers gentle, soothing relief ideal for those seeking rest and relaxation. Betty's Eddies crafts premium chews that taste incredible while delivering dependable results. Whether you're managing occasional discomfort or simply preparing for a restful night, Orange Creme Ache Away PM combines sweet citrus taste with calming indica benefits in every bite.
